_note: El Rastro seller config, read by agent/rastro_seller.py. One entry per spare copy (asset id, not card ref). start_ask is the anchor used only when the asset has no live listing and no earlier price in today's log; floor is the least cash we keep (net of any fee we pay). The bot raises a floor to our private value + 1 if it is set lower, and skips an asset we no longer hold or whose card we hold only once (set allow_last_copy to sell a last copy). Set enabled to false to keep a line without selling it. Nothing is listed until the owner starts `run`. MAL-08 #501 sold Friday tick 147 at 28 P to t17; it stays here only to show the not-held path. The commons keep their lowest-serial copy (LAV-01 #39, LAV-03 #35, LAV-05 #38), which are not listed.
